+    all_users = store.get_all()
+    total = len(all_users)
+    start = (page - 1) * page_size
+    end = start + page_size
+    users = all_users[start:end]

+def handle_list_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    page_str = params.get("page", "1")
+    page_size_str = params.get("page_size", "10")
+
+    if not (
+        isinstance(page_str, str)
+        and page_str.isdigit()
+        and isinstance(page_size_str, str)
+        and page_size_str.isdigit()
+    ):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}
+
+    page = int(page_str)
+    page_size = int(page_size_str)
+
+    if page < 1 or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}
+
+    return 200, users.list_users(page, page_size)
